title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 23
description:
Experience the ultimate blend of comfort and personalized style with this custom Baseball Comforter Set from Jeminise. Designed for baseball enthusiasts, this set allows you to personalize your bedding, adding a unique touch to your bedroom decor while celebrating your passion for the sport.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own name, adding a unique and personal touch to your bedding.
  • Sporty Theme: Perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers, featuring a vibrant Baseball On Field pattern.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric with Whole-Piece Microfiber Filling for a soft, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat for quick drying and fluffiness.
  • Thoughtful Gift: An ideal gift for men and women, moms and dads, for occasions like Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, and Christmas.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection dyeing techniques to prevent fading and smooth, fine, compact stitching for lasting quality.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Selected Design Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Included Components Duvet Cover
Special Feature Breathable
Thread Count 400
